name: example-exec-briefing-memo-decision-command
title: Executive Briefing Memo — decision command style
description: A one-page decision memo: the decision needed, a clear recommendation with confidence, key facts, tradeoffs, risks and next actions — compressed so a decision-maker can sign off in three minutes. The decision command style variant.

query.en: Turn these notes into a one-page executive briefing memo: the decision needed, a clear recommendation with a confidence level, key facts with their sources, a tradeoff table, risks and next actions.
